newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Lindsey says happy with state of US economy.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Lindsey says happy with state of US economy.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey pronounced himself happy on Thursday with the current state of the U.S. economy.
Speaking to reporters following a speech to the Investment Program Association, Lindsey said the economy's current performance lays a good base for longer-term economic growth.
Lindsey saw three keys to boosting long-term growth -- restructuring education, increasing savings and making the public sector more efficient.
"Our biggest threat on the capital side is a very low national savings rate," Lindsey said.
"It is not simply a matter of reducing the (budget) deficit," he added. "The main focus is that you've got to increase net national savings."
